text: How many holes does a straw have?
Some say zero: it's just a rolled-up sheet.
Some say two: one at each end.
Squash the straw down, and it becomes a ring. A donut. One hole.
The two ends are just the two openings of the same hole.
So how many holes does a pair of pants have?
Three openings. But how many holes?
Comment your answer. I'll reveal it in the next video.
